description: Get one order by its sevDesk id: an offer (Angebot), order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) or delivery note (Lieferschein), with its positions (name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, discount, optional positions), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross), tax rule, payment and delivery terms, recipient address, the order it was created from (origin) and related documents such as the invoices created from it (open them with sevdesk_invoice_get). Use it after sevdesk_orders_list.

id.description: Order id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_orders_list.

name: sevdesk_order_get
title: Get a sevDesk order
